name: Why is structural engineering coordination important for my construction project?
description: It's important to prevent costly clashes, delays, and ensure building integrity by integrating structural design with other systems.

mainEntity.name: Why is structural engineering coordination important for my construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Structural engineering coordination is critical because it identifies potential clashes between the structural framework and other building components before construction begins. Without proper coordination, issues could lead to costly on-site changes, delays, or even compromise the building's integrity. For instance, ensuring that a load-bearing wall doesn't interfere with plumbing lines or HVAC ducts is a key part of this process, providing process clarity by outlining potential issues.
